plan: Build and test a separate project-scoped append-only attempt ledger with reserve/result/reset events, unique attempt IDs and immutable history. Use canonical repository/task/operation/normalized failure-family/target identities; session, model/provider, source SHA, aliases and timestamps cannot reset counts. Also cap the aggregate unresolved operation/target episode so relabelling a failure cannot buy a third attempt.

Integrate ledger freshness/revision and actual-executor resource evidence into the existing plan/guard and scoped proofs. Keep planning read-only. Add an explicit ledger-reservation command which revalidates the decision under a compare-and-swap lock, appends and durably flushes one reservation before any caller dispatch; it does not itself dispatch. Lost result/uncertain dispatch stays parked until reconciled.

Provide a read-only Linux resource sampler and deterministic admission decisions using executor identity, cgroup limits/usage, CPU quota/usage deltas, disk headroom and declared task/review budgets. Produce reviewable canonical-row metadata and stop/cleanup recommendations; perform no process killing or deletion.

ledger_contract.state: Phase A uses explicit private scratch files for executable persistence/CAS proof. Live use requires a separately verified authoritative project backend durable across sessions; never use retired state/queue or call a disposable workspace copy authoritative. Missing live backend does not block offline proof.
ledger_contract.bound: One initial recoverable failure plus one evidence-based correction; the second parks that operation/target, with no third. First auth/permission/explicit-stop denial parks immediately across executors/providers. Missing/stale/corrupt ledger or pending/uncertain reservation fails closed for the affected action; unrelated fully evidenced eligible work remains selectable.
ledger_contract.concurrency: Bind decisions to ledger/backend revision; only one compare-and-swap reservation wins. Local locking proves one-host/shared-file atomicity only. No distributed guarantee or automatic live adoption is claimed.
ledger_contract.reset: Append a substantive, evidenced resolution/reset event without erasing lifetime history. Success polls, new sessions, provider/model changes, renames, source changes and timeouts are not resets. Technical work cannot reset an auth/permission denial or explicit stop.
ledger_contract.projection: Each canonical row has persisted stuck status, observed failure count or null, sanitized reason and ledger revision. Preserve operation-specific records and lifetime history behind the row; denial and unknown states cannot become clear through a missing projection.

exact_plan_equality_gate.status: Required collection prerequisite; no actual collection, independent verification or receipt has been performed by this registration.
exact_plan_equality_gate.enforcement_boundary: An explicit independently verified collection gate outside the existing shared validator. Current evidence_policy.py does not compare task.plans or canonical plans with submission.plans and can accept omitted non-check artifacts. This registration does not change that code or claim automated enforcement. The coordinator must withhold activation, guard consumption and completion acceptance until the independent collector's verified receipt exists for the exact inputs.
exact_plan_equality_gate.canonical_source: The independent collector resolves the independently accepted registration/amendment and merge to the authoritative canonical task repository, full commit, exact path and blob. Verify those citations and the acceptance/merge independently; an author-selected file, candidate task or plan digest cannot establish canonical authority. Use the accepted canonical task even when collecting a later candidate head.
exact_plan_equality_gate.input_binding: Read strict JSON from the authenticated canonical task, the task document at the exact candidate source head, and the complete actual submission payload to be consumed. Reject duplicate keys and non-finite numbers. Preserve the three captured byte sequences and their SHA-256 hashes. The collector verifies Git references against captured bytes and verifies that the actual engine input is the captured submission object (including its normalized complete-payload digest), not a later or different payload.
exact_plan_equality_gate.equality: Compare the entire plans object from canonical task, candidate task and actual submission. All criterion IDs, plan keys and values, method, artifact paths/types/check_id and any nested keys, source_paths, build, coverage and reviewer_id must match. Missing/extra/altered content fails, including any of the nine non-check entries. JSON object-member order is irrelevant; array order and values remain exact. Use UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) and compare canonicalized bytes directly; receipt hashes bind the inputs and do not replace the comparison.
exact_plan_equality_gate.independence: The collector/verifier must be distinct from the author and verify both source provenance and the comparison result themselves. Author-produced output, these local controls, role labels and a successful shared-validator result are insufficient. The coordinator records the actual verified receipt; this document contains no fabricated actor observation, authority or acceptance.
exact_plan_equality_gate.fail_closed: Any missing field, provenance discrepancy, unequal plans, comparator error/nonzero exit, self-verification, stale canonical acceptance or changed candidate/submission/operation/phase requires stopping and fresh independent collection. Run before each admission/activation and again at guard consumption and completion collection. Reusing an old receipt after any input/ref change is forbidden; all six original criteria and every planned artifact still require actual evidence.

reference_verifier.purpose: Reproducible stdlib-only comparison/control recipe, not an installed runtime gate or implementation helper. It reads explicitly supplied local files and writes only stdout; no credentials, network, engine calls or source mutations.
reference_verifier.collection_invocation: Use the identical program at command_argv[2] as: python3 -c <program> check <authenticated-canonical-task.json> <exact-candidate-task.json> <actual-submission.json>. Exit 0 means comparison passed only; exit 1 rejects unequal/missing plans; exit 2 rejects invalid input/read/usage errors. Independent provenance verification and a complete receipt are still required.
reference_verifier.negative_controls: Self-test compares an unchanged plan and reordered object members, then requires rejection of all nine non-check entries omitted together (submission, candidate and both), each entry omitted individually, each artifact path altered, missing/extra criterion or plan key, altered method/source/build/coverage/reviewer/type/check binding, extra artifact/key, changed array order, jointly altered candidate/submission, absent/wrong-type plans, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and malformed JSON. These copied fragments have no acknowledgment/authority and are never passed to a live engine.
